name: Prospective Clean-Sheet Shadow Validation
anchor_rule: Use the last available trading observation in a calendar month only after market data from a later calendar month exists. Never issue historical anchors before 2026-08-31.
universe_policy: Freeze the economic universe to the 167 R1/R3 tickers present at R4 inception. Future config additions do not enter R4 V1; operational query-symbol corrections for an existing frozen ticker are allowed.

avoid_target.definition: bottom 20% of realized future SPY-relative return within each evaluated anchor-date cross-section

prediction_immutability.rule: Once an anchor/horizon is issued it is never rescored, expanded, or rewritten.

outcome_immutability.rule: A matured ticker/horizon outcome is appended once and never rewritten.

prospective_bootstrap.method: moving block bootstrap over monthly prospective metrics

requires: mean monthly rank IC 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
top-decile mean SPY-relative return 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
top-decile SPY-beating rate 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0.50
top-quintile minus bottom-quintile relative-return spread 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
mean monthly ROC AUC 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0.50
top predicted-risk quintile precision 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0.20
top predicted-risk quintile mean SPY-relative return 95% bootstrap CI upper bound < 0

evidence_status_policy.PROMISING: 12 through 23 months and at least one frozen prospective evidence gate passes
evidence_status_policy.MIXED: 12 through 23 months without a passing frozen evidence gate
evidence_status_policy.CONFIRMED_PROSPECTIVE: 24 or more months and at least one frozen prospective evidence gate passes
evidence_status_policy.FAILED_TO_CONFIRM: 24 or more months and no frozen prospective evidence gate passes

annual_model_refresh_policy.cadence: Once per calendar year before that year's first prospective anchor is issued
annual_model_refresh_policy.feature_set: Frozen R2.1 SELECTED features above; no rediscovery
annual_model_refresh_policy.hyperparameters: Frozen Ridge alpha=1.0 and LogisticRegression C=1.0 L2
annual_model_refresh_policy.outcome_maturity: Training row outcome_end_date must be strictly before the model-year cutoff
annual_model_refresh_policy.registry_rule: Append a versioned model year; never rewrite an existing model year
